description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger An ally within 30 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Cost 2 Vitae

The table is where people die. You have not got them to a table yet, so they are not allowed to.

The ally is instead reduced to 1 Hit Point and is drained 1. You take 2d6 damage as their wound routes through your own grafted tissue, and this damage cannot be prevented or reduced.

cinderfall.incomplete: This effect changes a different creature's own roll, HP, condition, or item, sourced from the card holder's own passive/item/action. No selector exists anywhere in pf2e-source for this -- confirmed corpus-wide this pass. This is the ally-targeting version of the 0-to-1-HP floor; Orc Ferocity's real precedent is explicitly self-targeting and does not extend to protecting a different creature.
